_comment: Curated per-target links for the dashboard cards (website / github / docs / explorer / twitter / discord). Keyed by target key; matched fuzzily (equal / substring / shared 6-char prefix) to registry keys, so 'krystal-community-vault' matches the long address-suffixed key. Survives registry rebuilds (registry.json is auto-generated; this file is hand-curated). Auto-explorer is derived from chain+address when no explorer is set here. Only add links you are confident are OFFICIAL (a wrong social link is worse than none).
